therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Reduced-intensity conditioning regimen (fludarabine, busulfan, total-body irradiation) with allogeneic stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Reduced-intensity conditioning to enable donor stem cell engraftment while preserving graft-versus-leukemia effect
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Replacement of malignant hematopoietic system with healthy donor cells and immune-mediated anti-tumor effect
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with high-risk hematologic malignancies including AML, CML, lymphomas, myelodysplastic syndrome, and other blood cancers

biomarker_changes: CD4+ T-cell recovery: 66.9 cells/mm³ at day +28, 173.7 cells/mm³ at day +90
CD8+ T-cell recovery: 109.9 cells/mm³ at day +28, 343.1 cells/mm³ at day +90
safety_signals: Acute GVHD: Grade 1 (5 patients), Grade 2 (15 patients), Grade 3 (3 patients), Grade 4 (3 patients)
results.dose_information: Reduced-intensity conditioning with fludarabine phosphate IV, busulfan IV, total-body irradiation, followed by allogeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplant with tacrolimus and mycophenolate mofetil for GVHD prophylaxis

context.comparator: Historical controls (hypothesis rejected if 95% CI for 1-year DFS entirely above 0.35)
context.duration: Treatment with conditioning regimen followed by transplant, with follow-up to 3 years
